mapper.insert: insert into sys_sign_profile_supplement_audit ( request_id, employee_id, request_hash, field_mask, status, create_by, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{requestId}, #{employeeId}, #{requestHash}, #{fieldMask}, 'PENDING', #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate() ) on duplicate key update request_id = values(request_id)
mapper.select: select audit_id, request_id, employee_id, request_hash, field_mask, before_hash, after_hash, status, create_by, create_time, update_time from sys_sign_profile_supplement_audit where request_id = #{requestId} limit 1 for update
select user_id from sys_user where user_id = #{employeeId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0' for update
mapper.update: update sys_sign_profile_supplement_audit set before_hash = #{beforeHash}, after_hash = #{afterHash}, status = 'COMPLETED', update_time = sysdate() where audit_id = #{auditId} and status = 'PENDING'
